messages:
mia.support: heads up — we have a customer (ACME Analytics) reporting a canary rollout health chart stuck as 'In Progress' in Console for >2h. They say traffic is routed to canary and logs show success, but chart never transitions. Ticket #INC-4567. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/ti/INC-4567

sam.eng: can you paste the canary id + route? i'll check status-sync and the canary status API quickly

mia.support: canary id = canary-abc123, route = /v1/generate, tenant = acme-eu. Customer tried browser hard refresh and incognito, no change.

status-sync-bot: metrics/rollouts stream lag detected in eu-west: stream=rollout-status, lag=115m, consumer=status-sync-eu, last_event_ts=1769947600

vikram.sre: i ran a quick check:
```
$ curl -s https://internal-api.reddemo/canaries/canary-abc123/status
{"id":"canary-abc123","progress":"success","complete":true,"status_ts":1769951200}
```
Console still shows In Progress for tenant acme-eu. looks like status events aren't reaching the charting pipeline / cache.

sam.eng: checking kafka consumer offsets for consumer-group 'status-sync-eu' — looks odd. sample from consumer admin:
```
group: status-sync-eu\ntopic: rollout-status partition: 4 current-offset: 4521 end-offset: 4521 lag: 0
```
but logs show repeated commit errors shortly before the gap:
```
[status-sync] ERROR commit failed: OffsetOutOfRangeException at org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.internals
[status-sync] WARN dropping event: event_id=evt-98765 reason=DuplicateEvent
```

jen.prod: customer impact is medium-high (dashboard stale). bumping priority. any quick mitigations we can push while eng debugs? :eyes:

vikram.sre: temp mitigation i tried: flush the canary status cache for that tenant via admin API -> POST /admin/cache/flush?key=canary_status:acme-eu:canary-abc123 . for my test tenant the chart updated ~2m after flush. can you ask customer to try again? note: cache is region-scoped, flushing in us-west won't help eu-west.

mia.support: customer tried incognito and we asked them to log out/in; no change. they're in eu-west. i flushed cache in eu-west as you suggested but they still saw stale chart. they reported console shows 'in progress' while pod logs show rollout finished and traffic at 100%.

vikram.sre: looking deeper at status-sync pod logs in eu-west, i'm seeing:
```
[status-sync] INFO pushing event evt-98765 to metrics-service
[status-sync] ERROR metrics push failed: POST /events 429 TooManyRequests - retrying in 30s
[status-sync] ERROR max retries reached for evt-98765, moving to dead-letter-topic
```
so the status-sync service got 429s from metrics-service and moved events to DLQ — charting pipeline never received the state change. that matches the symptoms.

sam.eng: thanks. reproducing steps for engineering:
1) trigger canary rollout on eu-west tenant (canary-abc123)
2) tail status-sync logs: kubectl -n infra logs -l app=status-sync -c sync --since=2h
3) observe 429s when pushing to metrics-service -> events drop to DLQ -> Console shows stuck 'In Progress'

metrics-bot: alert: metrics-service rate limiter tripped in eu-west between 1769946000 and 1769950000. peak qps=820 (limit=500).

vikram.sre: mitigation applied: scaled status-sync deployment to 3 replicas in eu-west and temporarily increased metrics-service rate limiter for rollout-events to 1200 qps. i also flushed the cache again.

mia.support: updated ticket INC-4567: applied mitigations (scale + cache flush). customer confirms their canary chart just updated to Completed. they want a root-cause and fix.

jen.prod: moving to permanent fix: we need better retry/backoff and 429 handling in status-sync (don't ACK to upstream until persisted), plus alerting on DLQ writes and region-specific chart staleness. assign to eng-runtime. @sam.eng @vikram.sre please own follow-up and patch.

sam.eng: opening internal issue INF-2029: title="status-sync drops events on 429 -> DLQ causing canary charts to stay 'In Progress'". will include logs, consumer offsets, DLQ payloads. ETA for hotfix (retry/429 handling + immediate patch): ~4h.

vikram.sre: i'll add an alert for DLQ writes > 1/min and consumer lag > 0 for >5m for status-sync-eu. also adding a dashboard panel for region mismatch between canary status API vs charting ingestion.

mia.support: marking customer ticket pending engineering fix. they'll keep monitoring. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

jen.prod: please post the postmortem and deploy notes when INF-2029 is resolved. we should also add a short KB for support with mitigation steps (cache flush, scale replicas, confirm DLQ).

sam.eng: will do. INF-2029 created and assigned. logs & repro saved in the issue.
